legend-grand-tour-of-switzerland.slogan: Grand Tour of Switzerland – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-grand-tour-of-switzerland.story: Switzerland's signed scenic driving route: 1,643 km linking twelve UNESCO sites, five alpine passes and twenty-two lakes. It is a marked touring route rather than a single road, so you meet it in pieces - the piece here follows the Seestrasse along the eastern shore of Lake Zurich through Küsnacht, Meilen and Stäfa before turning inland.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: For 23 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Col de la Croix
scenicChapters.narrative: 34 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
